item.description:
p∞l 0.7.1 removes the experimental BRAIN workspace from the live application while it is redesigned. Existing BRAIN rounds and choices remain safely preserved in the team archive; this update does not alter images, projects, captions, embeddings, notes, Press, Links, tokens, or local thumbnail caches.
The release continues to update existing Pool and legacy HORUS installations in place through the same signed Sparkle feed.

p∞l 0.7.0 is the Pool rename release. It introduces the new blue pool icon and p∞l identity while preserving the existing archive, local thumbnails, team URL, Keychain token, server API, and Sparkle update chain. Existing HORUS installations can update without downloading the archive again; fresh installs use Pool.app.
This release also includes the latest BRAIN workspace, PDF project support, full-resolution drag export, duplicate review, project downloads, filename search, and the accumulated archive reliability and interaction fixes through HORUS 0.6.14.

# HORUS 0.6.1
- Adds **Find more** to Concepts with at least three captioned and embedded images. - Learns from every hand-selected image in the Concept, combining meaning, visual structure, and caption similarity. - Searches across the complete archive and excludes images already assigned to the Concept. - Keeps all suggestions reviewable: select candidates and choose **Add to [Concept]**; HORUS never assigns them silently. - Preserves the compact HORUS interface and existing project, search, rating, and archive workflows.
